lines.rom: mamgala murati jaya jaya hanumanta mamgala mamgala deva ananta
hatha vajra aura dhvaja viraje kamdhe mumja janeu saje samkara suvana kesari nandana teja pratapa maha jaga vandana
lala lamgota lala dou nayana parvata sama pharata hai sena kala akala juddha kilakari desa ujarata kruddha apari
ramaduta atulita baladhama amjani putra pavanasuta nama mahavira vikrama bajaramgi kumati nivara sumati ke samgi
